mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index level above 235 indicates elevated inflation, triggering market expectations of aggressive monetary tightening which depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% MoM) combined with rising consumer spending (RSAFS growth exceeding 0.5% MoM) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong labor and consumer demand regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS growth rates exceed 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a turning point in the labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 5.0 within a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0% prior to the fall).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,150,000 units, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1150.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,150,000 units and consumer spending (RSAFS) is rising, the combination signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong housing and consumer spending regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 1150 and RSAFS growth > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.25% for three consecutive months, it indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been below 0.25% for 3 consecutive months.
